title: Tracking
description: A hazy Times Square night, the billboard towers smeared into vertical streaks that keep moving: columns stretch and re-sort, light drips slowly down from every sign, and the smear shimmers like footage. Live blob tracking runs on top, with thin green boxes locked to the bright signs, each with a number and a line of lisp, and your pointer is a tracked blob that fans lines out to the nearest lights.
intent: The TouchDesigner blob-tracking edit, done for real and in motion: a pixel-sorted smear that is redrawn every frame in drifting column strips with falling light drips, while bright regions are found with connected-component labelling each frame and held steady by a tracker in image space.
